snippet.title: LEGO Batman 3 Beyond Gotham - PS Vita Gameplay
snippet.description:
Gameplay recorded on a Playstation TV.

LEGO Batman 3 Beyond Gotham is one of the better LEGO games on the Vita, much better than the earlier Batman game.
